# synthetic-probe

> Synthetic HTTP probes in Go with typed failure reasons, capped body reads, an injected clock and doer, and a rolling SLO tracker with error budget remaining. Go module `github.com/Trysac/u235-synthetic-probe`, package `syntheticprobe`, MIT licensed, Go >= 1.23, standard library only.

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example, API

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run the tests and what they cover
- [Project](docs/PROJECT.md): objective, scope and out-of-scope
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): defended and not-defended limits
